spec: R0 pass-based transmission scheduling + R5 provisioning scenarios

visibility.source_of_truth: elevation predicted from the HELD STALE TLE only
visibility.diagnostic_use: dataset-only subset; not trained on before the primary result is known; S2 must not reverse between 10 and 20 deg
visibility.forbidden: generating UTC samples and filtering by elevation afterwards; using reference-element geometry to create or delete rows

pass_finder.method: event-driven: vectorized coarse elevation scan locates sign changes of (elev - threshold), each crossing refined by bisection
pass_finder.coarse_step_justification: a 10 deg LEO pass lasts >= ~4 min, so 60 s cannot skip an entire pass

sampling.offset_reference: between threshold crossing (entry) and threshold exit of the predicted-visible interval

identifiers.permanence: tx_id is assigned at schedule time and never reassigned or reused

no_168h_scenario: excluded unless it arises naturally from the fixed degraded policy
provisioning_rule: at t_refresh the endpoint receives the latest element with CREATION_DATE <= t_refresh plus a frozen model/scaler/gate, and holds them until the next scheduled event; no downlink beacon, no newly published element, no label feedback in between

age_treatment.primary: actual age_tx = t_tx - EPOCH(stale), reported as a continuous distribution
